risks.title: Economic recession and volume decline
risks.score_rationale: Risk listed first in Item 1A with very strong language ('material and adverse impact', 'could cause us to not reach our long-term growth goals'). Stable trend but structural to the sector. Macro-economic category = high weight for transportation operator.

risks.title: Third-party carrier failure risk
risks.score_rationale: Major risk at the core of the business model with strong language ('materially and adversely affected'). Positioned in central section of operational risks. Stable trend but increased by sectorial shortages. Critical for logistics provider.

risks.title: Technological disruption and AI competition
risks.score_rationale: New risk explicitly amplified ('accelerated adoption of automation and AI', 'disruptive technologies'). Strong language on competitive impact ('materially and adversely affected'). Positioned in central section. Technology = high weight for logistics broker.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT service interruption risk
risks.score_rationale: Detailed and explicit risk with very strong language ('material service outages', 'could result in service interruptions'). Internally developed systems = heightened vulnerability. Cybersecurity = high weight from regulatory and operational perspective. Upward trend (increasing sophistication).

risks.title: Tariffs and trade restrictions
risks.score_rationale: New and updated risk (2025) with already observed impact ('impacted our Global Forwarding business in 2025'). Strong language ('materially affected'). Positioned in international section. Geopolitics = high weight for global operator.

risks.title: Fresh product pricing and supply dependency
risks.score_rationale: Segment-specific risk with strong language ('materially and adversely affected'). Positioned in business risks section. Stable trend but structural volatility. Moderate weight as specialized segment.

risks.title: International regulatory compliance risk
risks.score_rationale: Detailed risk (OFAC, FCPA, GDPR) with moderate language ('reputational harm, substantial penalties'). Positioned in international operations section. Upward trend (continuous regulatory evolution). Regulation = high weight.

risks.title: Logistics talent attraction and retention
risks.score_rationale: Important operational risk with moderate language ('cannot guarantee'). Positioned in enterprise risks section. Upward trend (tight labor market). Moderate weight as manageable through HR policy.

ai_positioning.summary: C.H. Robinson positions itself as a leader in artificial intelligence applied to logistics chains. The company uses the concept of 'Lean AI' as a unique and disciplined method to apply AI at scale to achieve tangible business results. The company has expanded the use of generative and agentic AI to automate tasks once considered impossible to automate.
evidence: As a leader in Lean artificial intelligence (AI) supply chains, we deliver logistics like no one else.
Lean AI is our unique and disciplined method of applying artificial intelligence, at scale, to achieve tangible business results.
Our innovations with AI, machine learning, and data science benefit our customers, contract carriers, and employees and help power our growth strategy.
We have expanded the use of generative and agentic AI in our industry, creating proprietary technology to perform work that defied automation for decades.
Our enhancements to our dynamic costing and pricing models are key contributors to expanding our operating margins.
AI also frees our people from repetitive, mundane tasks so they can focus on more strategic work.
